## 3. Data Cleaning Methods

### 3.1 Handling Missing Values

|-------|-----------|----------|---------------|
| orders | order_approved_at ← order_purchase_timestamp | Fill nulls | 160 |
| reviews | review_comment_title ← empty string | Fill nulls | 87,656 |
| reviews | review_comment_message ← empty string | Fill nulls | 58,247 |
| products | product_category_name ← "others" | Fill nulls | 610 |

### 3.2 Removing Noisy / Inconsistent Data

| Table | Issue | Action | Affected Rows |
|-------|-------|--------|---------------|
| geolocation | lat/lng outside Brazil bounding box | Filter outliers | 42 |
| products | product_weight_g=0 → median (700.0) | Fix noisy | 4 |
| payments | payment_type="not_defined" | Remove noisy | 3 |
| fact | drop rows missing required dim keys or payment data | FK consistency filter | 21 |
| fact | order/delivery date must be in dim_date (2016-2018) | Date range filter | 0 |
| fact | drop rows with no matching geo_key | Geo FK filter | 289 |

| customers | Drop duplicates | on customer_id | 0 |
| geolocation | Drop exact duplicates | all columns | 261,822 |
| products | Drop rows | null physical dimensions | 2 |

## 4. Data Transformation

### 4.1 Datetime Parsing

All date/time string columns were converted to `pandas.Timestamp`:

- **orders**: order_purchase_timestamp, order_approved_at, order_delivered_carrier_date, order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date
- **order_items**: shipping_limit_date
- **reviews**: review_creation_date, review_answer_timestamp

### 4.2 Feature Engineering (Derived Columns)

| Column | Formula | Purpose |
|--------|---------|---------|
| `delivery_lead_time_days` | `delivered_customer_date − purchase_timestamp` (days) | Actual delivery duration |
| `is_late` | `delivered_customer_date > estimated_delivery_date` → 1/0 | Late delivery flag |
| `total_order_payment_value` | `SUM(payment_value)` grouped by order_id | Aggregated order payment |
| `primary_payment_type` | `FIRST(payment_type)` grouped by order_id | Primary payment method |
| `sentiment_label` | Score 4–5 → Positive, 3 → Neutral, 1–2 → Negative | Review sentiment |

### 4.3 Categorical Encoding / Transformation

| Column | Transformation |
|--------|---------------|
| `product_category_name` | Translated Portuguese → English via lookup table |
| `review_score` | Mapped to `sentiment_label` (Positive/Neutral/Negative) |
| `is_late`, `is_weekend` | Boolean → integer (0/1) |

## 5. Data Integration

### Star Schema Design

The 9 source CSV files were integrated into a **star schema** with 6 dimension tables and 1 fact table:

```
                    dim_date
                      │  │
          order_date_key  delivery_date_key
                      │  │
dim_customers ── fact_order_items ── dim_products
                   │    │    │
          dim_sellers  dim_geo  dim_reviews
```

### Integration Steps

| Step | Action | Key | Result |
|------|--------|-----|--------|
| 1 | Aggregate payments by order_id | `order_id` | 99,437 rows |
| 2 | order_items ← orders | `order_id` | INNER JOIN |
| 3 | + payments_agg | `order_id` | LEFT JOIN |
| 4 | Compute delivery_lead_time & is_late | — | Derived |
| 5 | Drop undelivered orders | — | −2,454 rows |
| 6 | Map surrogate keys from dims | FK columns | Lookup |
| 7 | FK consistency filter | All FKs | Final: 109,886 rows |

---

## 6. Feature Selection

The fact table was designed for **two data mining targets**:

| Target | Source | Type |
|--------|--------|------|
| Customer satisfaction | `dim_reviews.review_score` | Classification (1–5) |
| Delivery performance  | `fact.delivery_lead_time_days`, `fact.is_late` | Regression / Classification |

**Selected attributes in fact table** (matching `schema.sql`):

| Attribute | Type | Role |
|-----------|------|------|
| `price` | DECIMAL | Measure — product price |
| `freight_value` | DECIMAL | Measure — shipping cost |
| `total_order_payment_value` | DECIMAL | Measure — total payment |
| `primary_payment_type` | VARCHAR | Attribute — payment method |
| `delivery_lead_time_days` | INT | Measure — delivery duration |
| `is_late` | BOOLEAN | Flag — late delivery |
| `customer_key` | FK | Link to dim_customers |
| `product_key` | FK | Link to dim_products |
| `seller_key` | FK | Link to dim_sellers |
| `order_date_key` | FK | Link to dim_date |
| `delivery_date_key` | FK | Link to dim_date |
| `geo_key` | FK | Link to dim_geography |
| `review_key` | FK | Link to dim_reviews |
